      <title>The Coward King and the Madman in the Palace</title>
      <description>Chapter 10 of the Vijayanagara series tells how Krishna Deva Raya's hand-picked successor Achyuta Raya lost the great frontier fortresses of Raichur and Mudkal without a fight, then summoned the Sultan of Bijapur into his own capital, where the mad regent Hoje Tirumala seated Ibrahim Adil Shah on the Hindu throne and paid two million sterling in tribute — only for Tirumala to blind the royal elephants, grind the empire's jewels to powder between millstones, and impale himself on a sword as Rama Raya's troops broke through the palace gates. From the wreckage rises Rama Raya, the cunning son-in-law who will rule Vijayanagar from behind a puppet throne for the next twenty years. Based on A Forgotten Empire (Vijayanagar) by Robert Sewell (1900).</description>
